decision_rule: third distinct event timestamp; cases with finish payment at or before decision are excluded

outcome_rule.positive: first finish payment strictly after decision and at or before decision+180d
outcome_rule.negative: no finish payment through decision+180d and global log observation end at or after horizon

caveat: Global log end is only a source-level follow-up proxy. A passing count gate does not by itself prove individual-case outcome ascertainment or authorize model scoring.
